text: Epic complete: all four phase beads closed with verification receipts. The closure calculus is now publicly implemented, efficient, and honest: self-form views, rectangular cross-axis plans, and adjoint coupling all reachable from one plan vocabulary; query-first execution demonstrated at scale (selected pairs 20x cheaper than the full RDM, fused 4x faster than materialize-then-project, oracle 4.4e-16, no O(q^4) allocation anywhere); estimand identity carries the typed generalization axis and is route-stable; refusals are classed, introspectable, and curated in an executable failure gallery; the evidence ledger is artifact-linked and matches what the code actually does. Verified: 2127+ assertions 0 failures, R CMD check Status: OK, pkgdown site builds, Gate 5/Gate 2/failure-gallery beads closed on the novelty epic. Remaining open work lives where it was scoped: rsatoolbox parity (Gate 1), real rectangular exemplar (Gate 3), conservation demo (Gate 4), and the recorded 0.2 rename map.
